name: China Natl Uranium
summary: Operating both domestically in China and across international markets, China National Uranium Co., Ltd. specializes in the extraction, refining, and commercial distribution of natural uranium. Its product portfolio extends to include monazite, uranium-molybdenum compounds, and other relevant offerings. This company, established in 1989 and based in Beijing, China, operates as a subordinate entity of China Nuclear Uranium Co., Ltd.
